shared_elements: multiple figures arranged in a scene
raised-relief human head with detailed hair or headdress
offering-like objects or accessory forms beside figures
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief human figures standing upright with heads shown in profile-ish orientation, rendered with the same broad convention of raised bodies against a flat ground, and both include secondary carved forms flanking the main figure. However, A presents a complete multi-figure ritual scene with arms raised toward a seated/enthroned figure and a laden offering table plus a lower register, whereas B shows a single frontal-standing figure whose arms are held at the waist with only fragmentary neighbouring heads, so the specific relationships and compositional scheme do not match.
